source.title: Training Dynamics of Deep Network Linear Regions
source.authors: Ahmed Imtiaz Humayun; Randall Balestriero; R. Baraniuk

record.tranche_reason: The study trains an MLP on randomly labeled MNIST samples and includes training-accuracy curves, but its reported focus is local-complexity dynamics rather than the original fitting and test-error measurements.
record.gate_note: Figure 11 and its discussion report local-complexity dynamics during random-label training. Those complexity results do not measure the claim versions directly. The text also says training-accuracy curves are shown, but gives no textual outcome for them; the figure-only row records that limited evidence.
record.test_reason: The study trains an MLP on randomly labeled MNIST and reports training-accuracy curves in Figure 11, directly testing the fitting component of V1. Its supplied text does not reveal the curves' outcomes.
record.authors_conclusion: The record's paraphrase is accurate. The authors associate local-complexity phases with memorization and generalization, and report longer ascent and higher peak complexity for larger random-label datasets. Their central conclusion concerns partition regions migrating toward decision boundaries during training.
record.recipe_differences: The study examines local-complexity dynamics during MNIST training with randomized labels and varying training-set size, rather than reproducing the original fitting and test-error measurements.
record.method_sensitivity: Training-set size changes the local-complexity dynamics in the random-label setting: larger sets lengthen the ascent phase and raise peak train and test local complexity.

fits_no_version.finding: Larger randomly labeled training sets prolong the local-complexity ascent and increase peak train and test local complexity.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: For a depth 3, width 200 MLP on randomly labeled MNIST, local-complexity dynamics depend on training-set size.

fits_no_version.finding: Under induced grokking, memorization accompanies local-complexity ascent and delayed generalization accompanies its second descent.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Local-complexity phases track memorization and delayed generalization under the study's grokking setup.

record.problems: The random-label training-accuracy curves are figure-only, with no textual outcome or exact values. The reported local-complexity uncertainty intervals are described as 25% of the standard deviation, but no uncertainty for random-label fitting accuracy is stated.
record.rows_left_out: No local-complexity rows were included because those measurements do not directly test the fitting, timing, test-error, regularization, or learning-order outcomes in the claim versions.

untested.parts: Chance-level test error under randomized labels and a verified unchanged training recipe are not established. Near-zero training error is measured but cannot be determined from the supplied text.
Relative time to fit true versus random labels and convergence across corruption fractions.
Fitting shuffled pixels, independently permuted pixels, or Gaussian-noise training inputs.
Perfect training fit and steadily worsening test error across label-corruption fractions.
Random-label fitting with explicit regularization and true-label generalization after its removal. The regularization experiments describe local complexity instead.
Learning shared real patterns before noisy labels. Neither the local-complexity comparisons nor induced grokking establish this learning order.

record.verdict_notes: The absence of readable accuracy values warrants no support, scope-limit, or challenge label. Local-complexity ascent duration does not establish fitting time, and random locations used to measure complexity are not unstructured training inputs.

versions.untested_parts: The text says training-accuracy curves are shown for random labels, but does not describe their outcome. Test error at chance and whether architecture or training hyperparameters were unchanged are not stated.
